_note: A specified security or sweat equity shares allotted or transferred by the current or a former employer free or at a concession: "the fair market value … on the date on which the option is exercised by the assessee, as reduced by the amount actually paid by, or recovered from, the assessee" (S2 s.17(1)(d), (4)(h); 1961 s.17(2)(vi) and Explanation (c); D-121; rulebook PERQ-ESOP-001). The fair market value is the Rule's: a listed share's "average of the opening price and closing price" on the exercise date (on the highest-volume exchange where several); where it did not trade, the closing price on the closest preceding date; an unlisted share or another security, a merchant banker's value on the specified date (S4 r.15(6)–(7), Gazette 271092, pp.1547–1548; Rules 1962 r.3(8)–(9), consolidated rule 3, pp.4–5). The prices and valuation are entered; SpecifiedSecurityPerquisite computes the value and hands it in. Every employee; the income of the year of allotment. An eligible start-up's deferral (s.392(3); 1961 s.192(1C); PERQ-ESOP-002) changes when tax is paid, not this value — not modelled here (D-121 C3). Every regime.

provenance.whatToCheck: Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.3(8)–(9) is read in the Income Tax Department's consolidated rule 3, not in the Gazette: its words date from the substitution of rule 3 by S.O. 3245(E), 18-12-2009 (Notification No. 94/2009, the Income-tax (Thirteenth Amendment) Rules, 2009, in force from 1-4-2009) as corrected by S.O. 66(E), 12-1-2010 (Notification No. 2/2010), and neither Gazette copy is on egazette.gov.in (its 2009 Part II s.3(ii) scans stop before December 2009) — read them in a Gazette copy. The later amendments of rule 3 that the consolidation and the amendment list name are read in the Gazette (G.S.R. 415(E) of 2020, 452(E), 615(E) and 636(E) of 2023), and the Gazette amendment chain from 1-9-2025 to 31-3-2026 touches no part of rule 3 (docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-10-rule-3.md).
